title: A trayful lost, a handful hoped for
odia:
କୁଲାକ ଚାଉଳ କୁକୁରକୁ ଦେଇ
ଖୁଦ ମୁଠାକୁ ତୋ ଆଶା?
literal_meaning: After giving a winnowing-trayful of rice to a dog, you hope for a handful of broken rice?
meaning_odia: ବହୁତ ସମ୍ପଦ ହାତରୁ ଯାଉଥିବାକୁ ଅବହେଳା କରି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଲାଭକୁ ଆଶା କରିବା। କୁଲାଏ ଚାଉଳ ଛାଡ଼ି ଖୁଦ ମୁଠାଏ ଲୋଡ଼ିବାର ତୁଳନାରେ ଏହି ଅସଙ୍ଗତିକୁ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The question contrasts a large quantity already given away with a small amount still eagerly sought. The inspected gloss applies it to overlooking a substantial loss while concentrating on a minor gain. The focus is the mismatch in priorities.
usage_example: Someone ignores a large unpaid debt but spends hours chasing a tiny refund. A friend recalls the saying to question where their attention is going. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: A winnowing tray and a handful make the difference in quantity visible. Whole rice is then contrasted with broken grains, so the hoped-for return looks smaller in both amount and quality. The final question sharpens the rebuke.
